business_summary: Zhejiang Shaoxing RuiFeng Rural Commercial Bank Co.,Ltd provides commercial banking products and services in China. It offers personal wealth products and services that cover financial products, precious metals, funds, insurance products, and asset management products; savings, demand, time, structured, and notice deposit products, as well as certificate of deposit; personal, business, consumer, mortgage, operating, and e-flash loans; credit and debit cards, gold and platinum cards, and cards with VIP privileges; and mobile and online banking services. The company also offers financial management products and services; settlement products and services comprising electronic money transfer, bank draft, transfer check, promissory note, local entrusted collection, remote collection of payments, and collection and payment; cross-border RMB settlement, clean and import collection, export documentary collection, letter of credit document review/negotiation, letter of credit notice, foreign exchange remittance, and global forex. In addition, it provides blockchain instant loans, customs and trade e-loan, foreign exchange loans, import financing, - short-term export credit insurance financing, export invoice financing, forfaiting, export discounting, export financing, and packing loan under export letter of credit. The company was founded in 1987 and is based in Shaoxing, China.
business_summary_ko: Zhejiang Shaoxing RuiFeng Rural Commercial Bank Co.,Ltd는 중국에서 상업 은행 상품과 서비스를 제공합니다. 금융 상품, 귀금속, 펀드, 보험 상품, 자산 관리 상품을 포괄하는 개인 자산 상품 및 서비스를 제공합니다. 저축, 수요, 시간, 구조화, 통지 예금 상품 및 예금 증서; 개인, 기업, 소비자, 모기지, 운영 및 e-플래시 대출; 신용카드 및 직불카드, 골드 및 플래티넘 카드, VIP 특권 카드; 모바일 및 온라인 뱅킹 서비스. 이 회사는 또한 재무 관리 제품 및 서비스도 제공합니다. 전자화폐이체, 은행어음, 이체수표, 약속어음, 현지수탁추심, 원격지급추심, 추심지급 등을 포함하는 결제상품 및 서비스 국경 간 위안화 결제, 청정 및 수입 징수, 수출 서류 징수, 신용장 문서 검토/협상, 신용장 통지, 외환 송금 및 글로벌 외환. 이 밖에도 블록체인 즉시대출, 관세 및 무역 전자대출, 외환대출, 수입금융, 단기수출신용보험금융 등을 제공한다.
